title: bihai villosa
intro: Bihai villosa, commonly known as Bihai or Chinese Angelica, is a plant species native to China, belonging to the family Apiaceae. The health benefits of Bihai villosa include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of Bihai villosa include its ability to exhibit sedative, anti-convulsant, and anti-arrhythmic properties, making it a potential treatment for various neurological disorders. Bioactive constituents of Bihai villosa include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
